svg.text: Twelve components. Colour marks the subsystem each one belongs to. Drawn for this document, so nothing here carries a third-party image licence.

g.text: every real-time decision, servo and motor
B+/B− wired straight from the pack
12 V, hall encoder on the shaft
own 6 V rail — stall spike isolated
SPI. The heading is the truth
replaced an MPU6050 — too much drift
three channels used: ToF, ToF, colour
own board · 10-pin IDC to the carrier
RGB + clear, with its own LED
reads the orange and blue corner lines
obstacle ranges for the fusion loop
USB · asyncio sealed in one thread
distance stays ∞ — the lidar fills it
one master switch breaks logic rails
